title: 0.14.0: the Lore pane's links panel, forward history, and a Query tab (opum-doc#633)
description:
Operator instruction 2026-10-03 (opum-doc seq 181, ODOC-OP-2026-10-03-12, read verbatim on opum-agent OPAG-1094 at origin/dev 4bb5854c): start research on following document links, showing some form of graph, and querying it. Design: opum-doc docs/reference/pane-links-and-graph-design.md (opum-ai/opum-doc#633, main 04e7646) -- read it there.

v1: a Links panel on the Read tab built from lore graph <id> --depth 1 --json, inbound and outbound neighbours grouped by edge kind as keyboard-reachable Buttons with digit hotkeys 1-9, which also fills ConceptDoc.links; forward history beside Back; a Query tab with path, impact and orphans, showing truncated or complete on every answer; and an optional tab: query on the dashboard tool.

FIRST: verify per surface that relative links press -- the API doc says links outside https, http and file draw as text -- and report the result.

CLI gaps to close within 0.14.0, scheduled as we see fit: a bounded inbound/outbound neighbour list with edge kinds (lore read returns no links today), and --type and --max-nodes on lore graph.

NOT in 0.14.0: a drawn graph (dagre or graphology as Raster or Svg), a Graphviz Image, and a lore explorer handoff. Report issues with this design to opum-doc; make no design calls. Filed 2026-10-03, not to be started until opum-ai/lore-cli#476 is merged and the restart is behind us.
